mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-rate environments are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% and housing starts exceed 1,300,000 units, it signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 700,000 million dollars) and a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%) signal economic overheating, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-unemployment environments are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-inflation environments are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
